verdict.rationale: Statsig documents A/B and A/B/n experiments: users are split into control and one or more test groups, scorecards carry primary and secondary metrics, and results report metric lifts with confidence intervals. Autotune bandits shift traffic toward and identify a winning variant, and Layers manage experiments alongside feature flags. Community users corroborate its experimentation rigor. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of running an experiment directly on an existing feature gate, and hands-on corroboration of the winner/results view.
